decision_conditions: <p><span id="docs-internal-guid-448004a9-7fff-1dd8-a9a8-25d10065db6a"></span></p><p dir="ltr" style="line-height:1.2;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt;"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">The proposed development, by reason of its size, massing, and scale, would result in an obtrusive and incompatible form of development, which would harm the green and open character of the rear garden area through incremental urbanisation. The proposal </span>fails to respect the character and appearance of the subject property and the wider area. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies LP1 and LP17 of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and policies D3, D4, and D6 of the London Plan (2021) and Hackney's Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).</p>

<p>Use of the proposed outbuilding, as habitable accommodation, would result in sub-standard accommodation, by reason of its location in the rear garden with no separate access, lack of private amenity space, and by reason of its size and location, would result in noise and disturbance to neighbouring amenities. As such, it would be contrary to policies LP1 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-063f6d79-7fff-6646-cbb2-9034e88d4809"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Design Quality and Local Character), </span></span>LP2 (Development and Amenity),&nbsp; and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan LP33 (2020), and policies D1 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-a7b85e9c-7fff-d531-81f7-9c679c9c84d1"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">London’s form, character and capacity for growth), </span></span>D3 (<span id="docs-internal-guid-7eb2bb05-7fff-65b6-9834-ecd7bc52c122"><span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach)</span></span>&nbsp;D4 (Delivering good design), D6, (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; vertical-align: baseline;">Housing quality and standards</span>) of the London Plan (2021) and the National Technical Housing Standards (2015).&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p><span id="docs-internal-guid-3f5fa89d-7fff-edfe-ed7b-a9c234cf205c"></span><br></p>

<p>In the absence of a Unilateral Undertaking or a Section 106 Agreement securing appropriate mitigation by restricting future occupiers of the development from obtaining parking permits within the Controlled Parking Zone, the proposed development would likely exacerbate existing parking stress and congestion on the surrounding highway network. The development would, therefore, be contrary to policies LP43 (Transport and Development) and LP45 (Parking and Car-Free Development) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020) and policies T4 (Assessing and mitigating transport impacts) and T6 (Car parking) of the London Plan (2021).</p>
description: Demolition of existing outbuilding and replacement with a single storey outbuilding to end of garden.
